purpose: Calibration check of the phase-posterior uncertainty u_k against the nominal noise scale; no training, no selection.
frozen_receiver: tcom_reliability_20261021 incumbent: tcom_hybrid_20261020.inference.hybrid routing with results/tcom_hybrid_sensitivity_20261020/protocol.json proposal_policy; adaptive and global starts from tcom_start_ablation_20261020.starts.load_starts

starts.receiver: the frozen receiver's own spectral initialization
starts.random: poor start: g0_k = sqrt(p_k) * CN(0, I_N), with p_k the per-user power of the spectral start (observable), independent of the true channel

stages: 1..10 are the learned stages of the start family the receiver routes to (adaptive at or below 30 dB, global above). Stage 11 is the final-filter input after the policy's extra EM tail; for SNR <= 20 dB the receiver applies no tail or final filter, and stage 11 is then the receiver output.

recorded_per_stage_and_user.a_predicted: u_k = mean_n Re[Cov(g_n)]_kk from Var = Z^2 (1 - R(kappa)^2), at the mean M = G S + B used by that stage's EM step (stage 11: at the final-filter input)
recorded_per_stage_and_user.c_actual: ||g_dc,k - g_true,k||^2 / N, g_dc the relaxed EM output entering the stage's Hankel filter (stage 11: the final-filter input)

bias_subset: 16 channels per main cell (receiver start), 16 independent noise draws per channel with G, S, B fixed. bias_k = ||mean_r g_dc,k - g_k||^2 / N; fraction = sum(bias) / sum(mean_r actual). Small-sample bias correction: subtract (1/R) * within-channel variance.
truth_use: True channels are used only to compute c_actual and the bias fraction (scoring and this calibration diagnostic). Never as model input or for any selection.

statistics.spearman: computed on (a, c) and (b, c) pairs over records (stage x user x channel x seed)
statistics.uncertainty: 95% percentile interval from a cluster bootstrap over channels (1000 resamples, seed 2026103013)
statistics.ratio: median and geometric mean of a/c and b/c

gate_1.clearly_better_overall: rho_a - rho_b >= 0.05 on the pooled receiver-start records AND the bootstrap 95% interval of rho_a - rho_b excludes 0
gate_1.no_worse_in_any_major_group: rho_a >= rho_b - 0.02 in every major group: each stage, each RSR (incl. weak reference), each path regime, each SNR, receiver start, poor start
gate_1.per_cell_note: Within a single cell the nominal scale is nearly constant (only S varies), so per-cell rho_b is near zero by construction. Per-cell values are reported but are not part of the gate.
